topic: Why Bitcoin hashes each header twice
hook: Bitcoin miners hash every header twice, on purpose.

scenes.narration: Each block header is run through SHA-256 twice. That is called double SHA-256.
The result is compared with the network target. It has to be at or below it to count.
Every node uses the same rule, so anyone can repeat the check and get the same answer.

cta: Did you know it was twice? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Why Bitcoin Hashes Twice (Double SHA-256)
description_body: Each block header is hashed twice and compared with the target.
